text_blocks.snippet: Most people with mild COVID-19 can recover at home with supportive care. Treatment focuses on managing symptoms like fever and cough, and getting adequate rest and hydration. Over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help with fever and aches. If you have emergency warning signs, seek immediate medical attention.
snippet_highlighted_words: managing symptoms like fever and cough, and getting adequate rest and hydration

list.snippet: Rest: Get plenty of sleep and avoid overexertion.
Hydration: Drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated.
Over-the-counter medications: Use acetaminophen (Tylenol) or ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) to relieve fever, headaches, and body aches.
